requirement: v2.2.6: the in-conversation search (search conversation, the header magnifier) counts matches across the whole rendered conversation instead of only the viewport, and starts searching 1s after the last keystroke instead of 3s

assertions.defect: the walk was restricted to the current viewport and stopped counting at six matches, so a word that existed only above the fold reported 0/0 and the feature looked broken; the 3s settle made every query look ignored for its first three seconds
assertions.scope: paintSearchMarks walks every text node under the conversation region (falling back to document.body), counts every occurrence, and wraps at most 120 of them -- the cap bounds paint cost, not the count; counting stops at 2000 matches so a one-letter query cannot stall the UI
assertions.settle: the query settles 1000ms after the last keystroke (was 3000ms); Enter searches immediately; the count shows an ellipsis while the query is still being applied
assertions.no_viewport_filter: the viewport rectangle filter and its six-match ceiling are gone, and the scroll-triggered repaint is removed because marks persist once painted
assertions.client_bundle: test/client-bundle.test.mjs 36/36, including the rewritten contract assertions: 1s settle string, no viewportRect, count is ranges.length, no scroll repaint
assertions.loader: test/loader-entry.test.mjs 10/10 against the packed 2.2.6 artifact in the real DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 desktop runtime (entry active, tools registered, client half composed and activated, page booted in a browser)
assertions.installed: the packed 2.2.6 tarball is installed in this machine's desktop profile from ~/.dsh/w2m/w2m-dsh-plugin-2.2.6.tgz, so the running app serves the fixed client bundle on its next page load
assertions.artifact: scripts/pack.mjs packs dist/twinsearth-w2m-dsh-plugin-2.2.6.tgz deterministically from this tree; the published sha256 is the one release.yml writes into dist/SHA256SUMS beside the tarball, so the record does not restate the hash of the archive that contains it
